newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's MEFF equity volume at record high in May.
newsitem.headline: Spain's MEFF equity volume at record high in May.

text.p: The trading volume in equity financial derivatives on Spain's MEFF futures exchange rose in May to a record high of 726,430 contracts, 114 percent higher than a year ago.
In a statement, MEFF said the accumulated figure for the first five months of 1997 was 3.19 million contracts, up 58 percent versus the year-ago period.
Traded Ibex-35 futures contracts reached 420,588, with a daily average of 22,136.
